transcript.text: Hello, Sehat Family Clinic, this is Riya. You can speak in English or Hindi. How can I help you?
Hi, I'd like to book a dentist appointment.
Sure, we have openings with Dr. Priya Iyer on Tuesday, 17 November at 10 AM, 11 AM, or 12:30 PM. Which time would you prefer?
May I have your full name and a 10‑digit mobile number to confirm the 10 AM slot on Tuesday, 17 November?
Aman Gupta, Tuesday, 17 November at 10:00 AM with Dr. Priya Iyer, phone ending 1234. Shall I confirm?
Your appointment is confirmed. Your booking reference is SFC-5977. Have a great day!
